final_message:
Configured DNS for all requested names and mail exchangers. All 60 PCs use the lab resolver; existing connections, addresses and routes were preserved.

The artificial root runs on pc1, the resolver on pc2, and the authoritative zones on pc3 (com), pc4 (net), pc5 (edu), pc6 (it), pc8 (org), pc9 (io), pc10 (gov) and pc12 (info). The existing `kathara/base` images support BIND, so no image changes were needed.

The configuration assumes an isolated IPv4 DNS hierarchy. Runtime resolution and mail delivery remain unverified; the BIND syntax-checking tools were unavailable locally. The MX records identify the requested machines, but do not configure mail services on them.
